messages:
sam: Hey team — I need ephemeral sudo to run a one-off pg_dump from the read-replica for a GDPR sample export for customer XYZ. Scope: orders table (id, created_at, status, email*). Will run on replica, redact emails after dump, and then delete raw. Requesting 45m window. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1234

louise-security: Quick Qs — why do you need email? if it's PII we should hash or mask. Confirm replica host and exact retention plan. Also include the redact script you plan to use. :eyes:

sam: Good call. We only need email to verify match against consent table; we'll mask to <redacted_email_hash>. Replica: replica-query-02.internal. Retention: no raw dump persists; I'll transfer redacted file to secure host /mnt/sec and rm raw. Here is the command I plan to run:

```
PGPASSWORD=$PG_PASS pg_dump -h replica-query-02 -U readonly -t public.orders --data-only > /tmp/orders.sql
./tools/redact_emails.py /tmp/orders.sql --hash > /tmp/orders-redacted.sql
scp /tmp/orders-redacted.sql sec-audit@10.2.3.4:/mnt/sec/gdpr/ && shred -u /tmp/orders.sql
```

devops: FYI per break-glass we need you to request JIT elevation via the console so the audit link gets attached. Please add audit tag gdpr_sample_1856789012 and set TTL 1h. Avoid uploading raw to S3; if you must we need encryption w/ KMS and object-level logging.

sam: Will do JIT request now and attach tag. Not uploading raw anywhere.

anna-legal: from legal — ok to proceed as long as only hashed emails and the export is limited to the stated fields. Please keep proof of deletion and share the redaction command/output in the ticket.

louise-security: Approving contingent on: 1) JIT request + audit tag 2) run on replica 3) redact script run and output uploaded to ticket. If all good, approve 1h TTL. :white_check_mark:

sam: Request sent. JIT request id: jit-98765. I'll paste the redaction log in the ticket after run.

sec-bot: Access granted via JIT (jit-98765) to sam for sudo on replica-query-02 until 2026-03-17T15:30:12Z — audit_id=gdpr_sample_1856789012

sam: thanks all — starting in 5m, will report back with artifacts in ENG-1234.
